'''Saban 9 (February 24)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - The [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] army [[travel]]s from [[Murandy]] to [[Tar Valon]] and begins its siege upon the city.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Rand]] orders [[Alanna Mosvani|Alanna]] to return to [[Cairhien]] and take [[Merana Ambrey|Merana]], [[Rafela Cindal|Rafela]], [[Bera Harkin|Bera]], and [[Kiruna Nachiman|Kiruna]] to [[Tear]] and deal with the rebels there.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Elayne]] meets with the [[Borderland]] rulers and convinces them to move south, towards [[Murandy]].
